name: aici-engine
description: Headless browser telemetry engine that captures console logs and uncaught runtime exceptions from a target URL.

tools.name: run_audit
tools.description: Load a URL in an isolated headless Chromium, capture console logs and runtime errors, and return a structured diagnostic report.

parameters.name: targetUrl
parameters.description: Full http(s) URL to audit, e.g. https://example.com

credentials.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
credentials.description: Google Gemini API key used for AI diagnosis of captured errors.
